newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil steady to firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil steady to firm.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil was notionally firmer on Thursday as early-August supply eased, traders said.
Dealers pegged the market at around $107/$108 a tonne fob NWE following sales earlier this week at around $107.

High sulphur straight-run fuel was notionally flat. A Spanish refiner bought one and possibly two cargoes on Wednesday. One was heard sold at $6.50 over the mean/mean of published quotes while the other was possibly done below that level. No more details were available.
